meta.hypothesis: T-C09-A: if f = frac((n+1)/phi) lies outside (psi^2... precisely outside (1/phi - psi^2, 1/phi - psi^3) = (0.2361, 0.8541), then n is circle-irreducible; such n have density 1/phi^2. meta.methodology: Scan n <= 10^6: compute f exactly via integer square roots; check every n with f outside the product zone is irreducible; measure densities by scale; within the product zone measure the irreducible fraction. For T-C09-B compare max factorisation length with log|nu'|/log|psi|.
